Package classification

Class GNNClassifier

java.lang.Object
classification.GNNClassifier
public class GNNClassifier extends Object
GNN classifier for handwriting style classification Each student is a node whose handwriting features are similar hence influencing each other's classication Trained weights are loaded from W1.csv [16x5] and W2.csv [3x16], exported from a PyTorch GCN trained to 96.04% accuracy on labelled handwriting data (CURSIVE, MIXED, PRINT_BLOCK).

    • classifyBatch

      public HandwritingStyle[] classifyBatch(List<HandwritingGraph> graphs, List<int[]> edges)
      Run 2-layer GCN over a batch of student graphs. graphs[i] = one student, edges connect similar students.
      Parameters:
      graphs - list of HandwritingGraphs — one per student
      edges - pairs defining kNN connections between students
      Returns:
      Returns predicted style index for each student.
